title: Lab par ye thi laila ki fuga haye mera kadyal jawaan
body:
LAB PAR YEH THI LAILA KI FUGA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
AB KAISE JIYE YEH TERI MAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
DIL ME TAMANNA THI BETA DEKHOGI KABHI TERA SEHRA, METTI ME MERE ARMAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
SAR PA MERE GAR HOTI RIDA MAI TUJH KO KAFAN DETI BETA, SHARMINDA HAI TUJH SE TERI MAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
<<DIVIDER>>
QAIME JO LAYI LAASHE PISAR GHASH KHAKE GIRI US DAM MADAR, KEHTI THI JIYO KAISE MAI YAHA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
ZAINAB KO YEH GHAM THA HAD SE SIWA THI KHOON ME DOOBI JIS KI RIDA, SAR PEET KE WO KARTI THI FUGAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
TUM NE JO SADA DI BABA KO RUQSAT HUVI BEENAYI DEKHO, AANKAO MEIN THA CHAYA SHAH KE DHUVA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
LAASHA TERA DEKHI REYTI PAR AB KAISE SUKOO PAYE MADAR, SAYE MEIN KABHI BAITHEY GI NA MAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAINAB NE TUJHE KITNA CHAHA NAZAU SE MURADAO SE PAALA, WO KAISE UTHAYE DAAG-E-JAWA HAYE MERE KAIDYAL JAWA
EK KARB KA MANZAR THA WO TAQI ZAINAB PAQAYAMAT KI THI GHADI, JAB KARTI THI MADAR ROKE FUGAA HAYE MERE KADIYAL JAWA
